title: Wgpu Winit Trunk Migration
description: Migrate the raw-wgpu OS/playground stack from browser-only wasm-bindgen/web-sys to winit windowing/input (native + web) and trunk build tooling, plus native hot-swappable plugin hosting.
summary: Completed winit+trunk migration end-to-end: ui/wgpu host, SemioApp, Rust icon atlas, trunk build/serve at /, dev-host port reuse, native semio-wgpu-native with libloading hot-reload, plugin_exports on all crates. E2E verify passes for lowpoly trunk boot; boot.ts DOM/wasm race fixed.
